name: External MCP profile access
protocol_or_contract: HTTPS; sessionful MCP Streamable HTTP with event-stream responses; JSON-RPC
identity_and_policy: Gateway OAuth access token bound to profile and protected resource; per-method and target-aware policy
data: Tools, resources, templates, prompts, completions, tasks, subscriptions, notifications, structured content
availability_and_recovery: One active gateway process owns every client session

name: Browser console access
protocol_or_contract: HTTPS; HTML; same-origin JSON
identity_and_policy: Encrypted HttpOnly SameSite session plus CSRF on unsafe requests
data: Installation projections, task controls, artifact workflows, and hosted MCP Apps
availability_and_recovery: Browser never receives gateway bearer; BFF replicas use encrypted cookie state

name: Console static application
protocol_or_contract: HTTPS static assets
identity_and_policy: CSP, frame denial, MIME sniff prevention, and same-origin referrer policy
data: React application assets
availability_and_recovery: Immutable build assets

name: Console to gateway administration
protocol_or_contract: HTTPS; gateway administration and artifact routes
identity_and_policy: BFF-held OAuth token; gateway policy and audit
data: Safe installation projection and explicit mutations
availability_and_recovery: BFF refresh rotation uses durable gateway token family state

name: Enterprise identity federation
protocol_or_contract: OIDC discovery; OAuth 2.0; JWKS HTTPS
identity_and_policy: Issuer, key, claim, tenant, client, scope, and protected-resource validation
data: Authorization requests, tokens, claims, public keys
availability_and_recovery: Unknown issuers or keys fail closed

name: Gateway OAuth service
protocol_or_contract: OAuth authorization code with PKCE; client credentials; client assertions; ID-JAG
identity_and_policy: Authorization server policy; rotating refresh families; replay detection
data: Authorization codes, access tokens, refresh tokens, metadata
availability_and_recovery: Durable compare-and-swap rotation and bounded duplicate delivery

name: Gateway hosted-server MCP
protocol_or_contract: Private HTTP; MCP Streamable HTTP
identity_and_policy: Short-lived Ed25519 internal assertion with audience, principal, tenant, labels, and scopes
data: Canonical server MCP requests and responses
availability_and_recovery: Gateway reconnects per request/session; server state is durable where required

name: Gateway hosted-server administration projection
protocol_or_contract: Optional private HTTP under a declared server admin mount
identity_and_policy: AdminRead or AdminWrite policy, audit, and short-lived internal assertion
data: Bounded projection of canonical domain request and response models
availability_and_recovery: Owning server reuses MCP models identities and state; the projection is never a second authority

name: Platform persistence
protocol_or_contract: SurrealDB WebSocket at database scope
identity_and_policy: Dedicated runtime credentials; tenant-scoped persistence APIs
data: Identity, policy, control, tasks, artifacts, recordings, agents, audit, outbox
availability_and_recovery: Transactional outbox is authoritative; LIVE is a latency path only

name: Installation bootstrap
protocol_or_contract: SurrealDB WebSocket at root scope
identity_and_policy: Separate bootstrap credentials
data: Ordered migrations, runtime user rotation, initial control revision
availability_and_recovery: Runs to completion before long-lived services

name: Task protocol projection
protocol_or_contract: MCP final task extension over Streamable HTTP event streams
identity_and_policy: Same principal and policy context as tool invocation
data: Task create, get, update, cancel, list, notifications, progress, result
availability_and_recovery: Projects the shared task runtime without a second task store

name: Task persistence
protocol_or_contract: Rust API and transactional outbox
identity_and_policy: Task owner includes tenant, principal, profile, server, and operation
data: Tasks, leases, inputs, results, provider jobs, retention pins
availability_and_recovery: Resume

name: Domain artifact operations
protocol_or_contract: Private HTTP through artifact client or Python SDK
identity_and_policy: Forwarded internal identity or task-bound write capability
data: Metadata, capabilities, uploads, downloads, grants, releases, share links
availability_and_recovery: Idempotent capability redemption and durable artifact records

name: Artifact byte storage
protocol_or_contract: Private S3-compatible API
identity_and_policy: Installation object-store credentials; Artifact service and bucket initialization only
data: Artifact blob bytes
availability_and_recovery: Tenant-derived storage keys and content integrity hashes

name: Authorized artifact download
protocol_or_contract: HTTPS GET or HEAD /artifacts/{profile}/{artifact_id}/download with one optional byte range
identity_and_policy: Gateway policy and audit; service-side authorization
data: Backpressured artifact byte stream on the installation origin
availability_and_recovery: No domain-specific byte route or storage redirect

name: Public artifact redemption
protocol_or_contract: HTTPS GET or HEAD /s/{token} with one optional byte range
identity_and_policy: Random read-only bearer; hash-only storage; expiry, limit, release state, revocation
data: Backpressured artifact byte stream on the installation origin
availability_and_recovery: Edge logging suppresses bearer path

name: Producer recording publication
protocol_or_contract: Producer-loopback Rerun gRPC
identity_and_policy: Loopback receiver; application and recording identities are validated before upload
data: Native Rerun log messages
availability_and_recovery: Forwarder applies persistent bounded backpressure and restart replay

name: Governed recording playback
protocol_or_contract: HTTPS manifest through Console BFF and gateway; recording-scoped Rerun Data Protocol over HTTP/2 or gRPC-Web; bounded live RRD
identity_and_policy: Gateway policy and audit establish a five-minute actor-and-recording session; standard Redap read token is host-limited; enumeration and mutation are denied
data: One stable dataset-segment URI with immutable shard layers and revision; footer-indexed chunks fetched on demand; recent live history under the same Rerun identity
availability_and_recovery: Derived Redap catalogs rebuild from the durable catalog and shards; live rollover refreshes the archive revision and hands off to a successor stream

name: Stream recording replay
protocol_or_contract: Read-only RRD files plus SurrealDB catalog
identity_and_policy: Canonical recording URI authorization; classification and labels propagate
data: H.264 VideoStream samples, timestamps, keyframes
availability_and_recovery: Replay captures one task-start snapshot of complete acknowledged parts

name: Stream native runner
protocol_or_contract: Closed JSON request and response or newline-delimited event socket
identity_and_policy: Operator-admitted graph and mounted configuration; owner-scoped live session or task filesystem boundary
data: Runner request, H.264 access units, detections, tracks, source indices
availability_and_recovery: One bounded subprocess per live session or replay task

name: DeepStream execution
protocol_or_contract: GStreamer, CUDA, NVDEC, TensorRT, NVIDIA metadata
identity_and_policy: Mounted approved engine and coherent host-driver libraries
data: H.264 frames, tensors, detections, tracks
availability_and_recovery: No CPU inference fallback and no Triton server process

name: Media provider submission
protocol_or_contract: Provider HTTPS API
identity_and_policy: Provider credential held only by media server
data: Bounded provider request and deletion request
availability_and_recovery: Submission binding commits before task detaches

name: Media terminal webhook
protocol_or_contract: Signed HTTPS webhook
identity_and_policy: Provider signature and unique event validation
data: Terminal event, output references, usage facts
availability_and_recovery: Webhook-only completion; missing delivery is operational failure

name: Analytical execution
protocol_or_contract: Embedded DuckDB API and arbitrary SQL
identity_and_policy: Owner-derived workspace and locked engine settings
data: Queries, mutations, ingests, exports, spatial operations
availability_and_recovery: Read work may resume; uncertain mutation is never replayed

name: Map acquisition helper
protocol_or_contract: JSON subprocess contract and filesystem exchange
identity_and_policy: Registered source policy, bounded paths, network controls
data: OSM, GTFS, maritime, aviation, and authority acquisition products
availability_and_recovery: Acquisition tasks persist durable state and immutable release identities

name: Map routing toolchain
protocol_or_contract: Local process and HTTP APIs
identity_and_policy: Container-local endpoints and governed active release
data: Routing tiles, route requests, matrices, reachable areas
availability_and_recovery: Active release dependencies are recorded with route products

name: Rerun viewer bridge
protocol_or_contract: MCP stdio child to Streamable HTTP parent
identity_and_policy: Gateway profile controls the external HTTP projection
data: Viewer MCP tools
availability_and_recovery: Bridge process owns child lifecycle

name: World recording publication

identity_and_policy: Producer-local transport; gateway policy later binds the registered application and tenant
data: SUMO world frames
availability_and_recovery: Recording Hub never polls SUMO

identity_and_policy: Single serialized owner; not published to host

protocol_or_contract: OTLP gRPC or HTTP
identity_and_policy: Installation-selected exporter and SIEM credentials
data: Logs, traces, metrics, audit-compatible events

identity_and_policy: Local operator access and development Secrets
data: K3s node, GPU runtime, images, ports, and kubeconfig
availability_and_recovery: k3d is the canonical local Kubernetes substrate

name: Kubernetes deployment control
protocol_or_contract: Helm and Kubernetes APIs
identity_and_policy: Installation operator RBAC and existing Secrets
data: Workloads, Services, Ingress, NetworkPolicy, volumes, mTLS annotations

identity_and_policy: SHA-256 checksums, resolved identities, SPDX SBOMs
data: Images, Helm values, schemas, manifests, evidence

name: Authenticated recording upload
protocol_or_contract: HTTPS; OAuth discovery; client_credentials with private_key_jwt; versioned protobuf
identity_and_policy: Resource-bound recording:ingest token; producer registration; tenant dataset application label retention and quota policy

availability_and_recovery: At-least-once retry resumes from Hub durable and materialized checkpoints

name: Gateway recording delivery
protocol_or_contract: Private HTTP; versioned protobuf
identity_and_policy: Gateway policy and audit; short-lived internal assertion addressed to Recording Hub

protocol_or_contract: Pod-private typed HTTP
identity_and_policy: Gateway-forwarded caller owns the MCP operation; the simulator adapter is not externally routed
data: Session state vehicle commands missions capture requests tiles and health
availability_and_recovery: Reads remain available during durable work; uncertain live mutations are interrupted-indeterminate

protocol_or_contract: Pod-loopback Rerun gRPC
identity_and_policy: Producer-local transport; registered application and tenant authority are enforced at gateway upload
data: Camera H.264 poses transforms IMU vehicles missions collisions and tile diagnostics
availability_and_recovery: Dedicated persistent forwarder queue survives producer or network restart

name: UAV simulator execution
protocol_or_contract: Isaac extension and Python APIs; USD; MAVLink 2; ROS 2
identity_and_policy: Pinned dependency identities; provider credential from Kubernetes Secret; canonical Frames identity
data: Rendered tiles camera frames multirotor state PX4 commands and telemetry

name: Live Stream publication
protocol_or_contract: RTP 2.0 with RFC 6184 H.264 over admitted UDP
identity_and_policy: Installation NetworkPolicy and one operator-admitted pipeline endpoint
data: Annex B H.264 access units with 90 kHz timestamps
availability_and_recovery: Live processing begins on arriving frames without resolving or waiting for Recording Hub

name: Recording catalog and shard access
protocol_or_contract: SurrealDB catalog; read-only footer-indexed RRD shards; complete acknowledged ingest parts
identity_and_policy: Tenant and data-label authorization precedes every physical playback or analysis plan
data: Logical recording metadata, immutable shard identities, and bounded writing-segment snapshots
availability_and_recovery: Immutable sources remain zero-copy; derived read state is reconstructible; task snapshots never read incomplete writes

name: Map travel-model handoff
protocol_or_contract: veoveo.io/travel-model-artifact/v1; map://travel-model identity; artifact occurrence and bytes
identity_and_policy: Caller access and labels apply at both domains; map release mobility profile restriction snapshot units and digest remain immutable
data: Controlled location and vehicle-type order; cost and transit-time matrices; unavailable arcs; provenance
availability_and_recovery: Optimization resolves the exact governed occurrence through the artifact plane and never recomputes GIS costs

name: Optimization executor control
protocol_or_contract: veoveo.io/cuopt-executor/v1; private Unix-domain socket; unsigned 64-bit big-endian length prefix; bounded JSON messages
identity_and_policy: Pod-local transport is not a public authority; task owner policy and artifact access remain in the Rust control plane; staged inputs are digest-checked
data: Health solve cancel and shutdown operations; prepared-problem path digest and bounds; solver result or typed error
availability_and_recovery: The control plane owns durable state and serial GPU admission; missing socket health version or digest fails readiness or the task

name: cuOpt GPU execution
protocol_or_contract: Python cuOpt 26.06 API; CUDA 13.2; RMM
identity_and_policy: Digest-pinned runtime and one visible NVIDIA GPU are mandatory; the executor accepts only compiled bounded formulations
data: Routing Solve and BatchSolve arrays; sparse mathematical models; solver controls; routes variables objectives duals and statuses
availability_and_recovery: No CPU solver or GPU-optional mode exists; incompatible cuOpt CUDA driver or GPU identity fails closed
